patterns: Direct firsts and years dominate: IFCI 1948 = first DFI / 'beginning of development financing' (APPSC), ICICI 1955, IDBI/UTI 1964, NABARD 1982, RESIDEX 2007.
Chronological ordering of IFCI-ICICI-UTI-IDBI-NABARD and apex-institution one-liners (NABARD = agri credit apex, IDBI = industrial finance apex).
APPSC tilts to microfinance (Yunus, Malegam, NBFC-MFI NOF Rs 10 crore) and refinance institutions (MUDRA, NHB); cooperative tier levels (DCCB = district).
Statement-style NBFC vs bank traps (demand deposits, cheques, DICGC, RBI registration) appear only in newer UPSC items.
App MCQs lean heavily on 2025-26 current data (SBR layers, Tata Sons UL, RDCL, AP Grameena Bank merger, AP tribunal jurisdiction) far beyond PYQ depth.
